title: Listen and repeat
intro: Listen to the English and repeat it as soon as it ends. Your voice is recorded and the next card comes up by itself.
paused: Paused. Continuing starts this card again.
saveFailed: Could not save the recording. Check the connection and try again.
micNote: Find a quiet spot and speak clearly near the microphone.
closed: Recording is closed after the deadline. You can still listen.
recordFailed: Could not make the recording. Try again.
checkBody: Say "one, two, three" out loud. If the bar moves, the microphone hears you.
checkHelp: If the bar does not move, check the headset or microphone and the sound settings.
quietStop: Nothing was heard twice in a row. Check the microphone and try again.
